items.headline: Packers RB Josh Jacobs pleads no contest to misdemeanor charges
items.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs pleaded no contest to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property at a court hearing in Green Bay, Wisconsin on Thursday.
